verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents percentage rollouts and gradual-rollout rules that can be scoped, ramped and scheduled, including release plans that ramp up automatically over time. Bucketing hashes on a user attribute, and all SDKs use the same assignment logic so the same attributes always get the same result. Because flags are served from the GrowthBook backend, with streaming updates, changes take effect without redeploying. Missing for 10: explicit docs that rollout rules (not just experiment rules) use sticky hash-based bucketing as the percentage increases; automated ramp schedules appear only on a higher pricing tier; no independent or hands-on corroboration of ramping 1% to 100%.
